question: What Is the Difference Between Floating and Grounded Voltage?
body_html:
Floating vs grounded voltage depends on the reference point: a grounded circuit has its zero tied to earth, while a floating circuit has no earth connection and can sit at any potential.

PointGroundedFloating
ReferenceFixed at earth potentialNot tied to earth, can drift
Fault pathLow impedance path trips breaker or fuseNo defined fault path
Ground loopsCan form between ground pointsIsolated from ground loop path

A floating design needs its own safety measures.
